messages.subject: [GSoC-17] keRas For Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
parts:
Hi,

I am a CS undergrad student from India. I have a lot of experience in deep learning and I am a Udacity Machine Learning Nanodegree Graduate. I have done a full-fledged project on using multi-scale CNN's in detection and recognition of Traffic Signs. Since I used Keras for that project and some others, I have a very good understanding of Keras. I have experience with coding in C++, Python and Java. I am also a contributor to Theano.

Since R does not have a high level modeling language for designing networks, creating a wrapper for Keras in R would be an essential capability for the R community. Keras has implementations over Tensorflow and Theano, with rich semantics and scalability.

I think rPython would be a very useful tool here. I want to familiarize myself with heavy usage of rPython for porting Machine Learning libraries, Are there any suggestions or contributions I could make which would help me with this task?

I have already finished all the tasks on the wiki page for this project idea.

Regards,
Wazeer Zulfikar
